bounds: two or three criteria (hard and deferred), at most one or two amendments, three separation levels

cases.purpose: Three criteria, one amendment at most: every property holds.
Two criteria, two amendments at most: every property holds.
A policy that accepts any separation: every property still holds, and levels are still recorded and shown.
When the grantor can record at most `helper` and policy demands `apart`, no amendment opens the way to delivery.
Fulfilment is reachable with a deferred gate in place.
A sufficiently separate owner's amendment can open the way to delivery, so amendments are live rules.
Planted defect: the worker's amendment takes effect.
Planted defect: the worker granting to itself keeps the separation level it wrote down.
Planted defect: an amendment below the policy's separation floor takes effect.
Planted defect: an amendment with no separation recorded is treated as a high level.
Planted defect: the report shows a higher separation level than the one recorded.
Planted defect: a gate is edited directly and the intent stays confirmed.
Planted defect: an intent the owner never confirmed is reported delivered.
Planted defect: an intent with no hard gate is reported delivered.
Planted defect: a hard gate whose check has not run is treated as passed.
Planted defect: an open deferred gate does not block fulfilment.
Planted defect: a level that is only declared is counted in full.
